title: SEASON ZERO M2: A DEATH ENDS THE PILLAGER
why: his rulings of 11-01 (round 5): a death ends the pillager and everything it wore and carried, stash cash, lifetime earnings, rank and the account stay; answer 31: quitting a raid early counts as a death; answer 28: in two player a pillager revived by the partner lives on. Plan m2 the lineage, build 1 of 5
now: every raid that settles (never the free walk back, a sim raid or the demo) adds to the living pillager: raids, extracts, kills and the best secured haul. A death or a quit with anything done ends the pillager into the hall with how (dead or quit), map, zone, killer, value lost, up to 7 lost item keys, a copy of the worn slots and the body look, and the next generation is born at once. The floor says it once on the next arrival: name is gone  pillager n. Stash, cash, guns kept, lifetime earnings and rank are not touched. Only his own death ends his pillager in two player; the player 2 window keeps today rules
